description.value: Quesada Burritos & Tacos is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain with locations across BC and the rest of Canada. The North Vancouver outpost on Lonsdale Avenue serves burritos, tacos, quesadillas, and nachos with customizable toppings including house-made guacamole and pickled red onions. It is a takeout-friendly stop well positioned along the Lonsdale corridor for cyclists passing through North Vancouver.
